artifact_definition: Persistent, reusable, versioned, and evolvable capability assets read, injected, invoked, or updated by runtime Processors.
principles: Artifacts store persistent evolvable capability content.
Processors read and inject artifacts at runtime hooks.
Target Agent sees artifact content, not Processor internals.
Evolution Agent may update artifacts through audited patches.
Seed content is benchmark-source-blind and intentionally generic.
